description: Sanitized excerpt from a real known-development local run on synthetic data. Identifiers, account state, endpoint details and full prompts are omitted.

sample_scope.authority: sample observations only; validator_results cover the file

evidence.title: Required fields
evidence.text:
# Required fields
Every imported customer needs name, email, signup_date, and subscription_tier. The name must be nonempty, trimmed, and at most 120 characters. Missing source columns require correcting the file; the system cannot supply invented defaults. country_code may be empty.

evidence.title: Subscription tiers and approved aliases
evidence.text:
# Subscription tiers and approved aliases
The destination subscription_tier permits exactly basic, pro, and enterprise. Northstar approves these explicit source-to-target pairs: starter → basic; professional → pro; business → enterprise. Category matching is case-sensitive after optional whitespace trimming. Other aliases, such as premium or gold, are undocumented and require a deliberate operator decision. Agents must not invent aliases.

evidence.title: Northstar customer schema
evidence.text:
# Northstar customer schema
Northstar is a fictional subscription product with one customer destination. Its fields are name, email, signup_date, subscription_tier, and optional country_code. Extra source columns are ignored only when the operator leaves them unmapped. Never infer a missing customer value.

evidence.title: Allowed transformations
evidence.text:
# Allowed transformations
An import mapping can rename a column to a destination, trim surrounding whitespace, parse a date using a selected format, and replace categories using explicit pairs. Category mapping applies to tier and country only. Date parsing applies to signup_date only. No scripts, SQL expressions, inferred values, concatenation, or arbitrary functions are accepted. Email normalization is an authoritative destination invariant.

application_findings.explanation: Slash date order requires explicit human selection. Select an explicit date format for signup_date.

note: The initial slash format was cleared by application code. Human selection remains required. This historical example is not a latency comparison with other inputs or warm states.
